one_sentence: The Master Equation defines coherence as the multiplicative integral of nine non-fungible factors, where any zero factor annihilates the whole.
executive_summary: This document presents the Master Equation of Theophysics, which defines coherence (χ) as the functional output of nine multiplicative factors (G, M, E, S, T, K, R, Q, F) wrapped by a free-will-dependent operator C_W. The equation is derived directly from the ten axioms of the Axiom Spine (Page 02), with each axiom demanding a specific variable. The multiplicative structure enforces a structural veto: if any factor is zero, coherence is zero, making all factors load-bearing and non-fungible. The equation has four equivalent forms: product (veto), ratio (combat), dynamic (engine), and field (wave), each revealing a different aspect. The dynamic form quantifies BC2, showing that without external Grace (G), coherence decays inevitably. The document includes Lean4 verification of the product and dynamic forms, and a complete glossary of the ten variables.
short_summary: This document is the formal presentation of the Master Equation, the central mathematical object of Theophysics. The core structural claim is that coherence (χ) is the multiplicative integral of nine factors, with a structural veto that zeroing any factor kills the whole. Key evidence includes Lean4 verification of the product form's veto theorem and the dynamic form's BC2 decay. This matters because it provides a rigorous, mathematically forced framework linking theological concepts to physical dynamics, with implications for understanding order, disorder, and the role of free will.

prerequisite_reading: Page 03 — The Witness, Free Will, and the Floor
